rule: No durable capability is duplicated without a row here classifying which instance is canonical (substrate) vs projection-native vs template. Duplicated equivalents must converge to one substrate home or be declared deliberately projection-specific.

capabilities.name: governed_mutation (approve/execute/proof)
duplicates: EOS app-side executeAction (action-executor.ts) — mirrors, races until W2 merged

capabilities.name: action proposal grammar ([ACTION:] tags -> pending row)
capabilities.note: The proposal-emission pattern is a RealityTemplate candidate: agent-emits-typed-intent -> governed pending row. Each projection instantiates with its own action-type variable set.

capabilities.name: projection read surface (readiness/activation/queue)
capabilities.note: The projection-owned-accessor + thin-transport-wrapper pattern (rules/projection-read-surfaces.md) is the standard shape; lyfeos/creatoros need their own accessors.

capabilities.name: AI agent chat surface
capabilities.location: EOS agents.ts:151 / LifeOS Nova (server/replit_integrations/chat) / CreatorOS ai.tsx
capabilities.note: Chat-with-agent -> optional typed-action-emission is one template with per-projection agent config + action-type variables. Do NOT collapse UX; extract the CONTRACT.

capabilities.name: task/kanban execution target
capabilities.note: Task schemas differ enough to stay projection-native; the WorkPacket primitive is the substrate abstraction over them.

capabilities.name: CRM / contacts
capabilities.location: EOS crm_contacts/deals/activities + LifeOS rolodex(contacts) + CreatorOS contacts

capabilities.name: documents / vault
capabilities.location: EOS documents + LifeOS documents(vault) + CreatorOS documents
capabilities.note: create_document is already a governed action type; the storage stays projection-native.

capabilities.name: gamification / XP / rank / progress
capabilities.note: Richest reusable UI/progress template set — feeds the template registry, not the substrate.

capabilities.name: reflections / journal / memory
capabilities.note: Memory/context sync is a substrate concern (Trace/feedback). LifeOS journal is a projection-native surface OVER the substrate memory, not a second memory.

capabilities.name: publishing / campaign approval
capabilities.note: publish-content is a future governed action type (approve->execute->proof), same loop shape as create_task.

capabilities.name: cockpit command surface (voice/text intent, panels)
capabilities.note: Cockpit is the ONE command surface + projection MIRROR. Projection native UX is NOT collapsed into it.

capabilities.name: template registry (RealityTemplate)
capabilities.note: New substrate home; taxonomy defined in reality_template_taxonomy.json / REALITY_TEMPLATE_GRAPH.md.
